name: Adjust
description: Adjust is a mobile measurement and analytics platform for attribution, campaign performance, deep linking, fraud prevention, audience insights, and data exports. App marketers use it to understand acquisition and engagement across applications and advertising partners.
agentUseSummary: Add a current customer-generated Adjust API token; agents can list a redacted bounded set of app IDs through one fixed Report Service filter endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: ADJUST_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Adjust API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated Adjust API token. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as a Bearer header to automate.adjust.com.

capabilities.label: Read app references
capabilities.description: Read at most 25 app IDs with names, account identity, attribution, campaign, event, device, revenue, and report data excluded.

approvalRequired.label: List Adjust app references
approvalRequired.description: Return at most 25 validated app IDs plus aggregate total and truncation state.

blocked.label: Access identity or app detail
blocked.description: Account/user identity, app names, store IDs, app settings, partner configuration, and API-token detail remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access attribution, device, or analytics data
blocked.description: Device and advertising IDs, installs, events, campaigns, partners, media, revenue, cost, fraud, audiences, cohorts, reports, raw data, and exports remain blocked.

blocked.label: Write or administer Adjust
blocked.description: App, event, signature, secret, link, tracker, callback, integration, device-history, token, user, and account changes remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary origins, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, dates, dimensions, metrics, filters, pagination, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded app-reference read requires approval; identity, attribution, reports, devices, writes, raw APIs, filters, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded read runs directly; token authority, fixed endpoint, redaction, caps, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed redacted Adjust Filters Data wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed redacted Adjust Filters Data wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: Adjust Report Service access requires an eligible customer account and a current API token with permission to read app filters.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin generates a dedicated API token and completes a live read-only Filters Data acceptance check.

evidence.supports: Adjust documents bearer-token GET /reports-service/filters_data, required_filters=apps, app filter IDs/names, and 400/401/403/429/503/504 responses.
Adjust documents customer API-token authentication for Report Service requests.
Adjust documents a broader JSON report surface for installs, revenue, ad spend, campaigns, apps, partners, dates, dimensions, and metrics; Relay blocks it.
Adjust documents customer-token app, event, signature, secret, settings, and migration management; Relay blocks these read/write/admin surfaces.

securityNotes: The API token is encrypted and sent only as a Bearer header to https://automate.adjust.com.
Relay allowlists only GET /reports-service/filters_data?required_filters=apps, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, and caps responses at 1 MB.
Output contains at most 25 validated app IDs, total count, and truncation state; names, identity, attribution, content, campaigns, devices, and analytics are excluded.
Reports, raw data, app settings, events, secrets, writes, administration, arbitrary filters/endpoints, pagination, retries, SDKs, bulk, and exports remain blocked.
Provider setup, token capture, permission assignment, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
